title: Re-Collecting a Returned Payment: Installment Payment Plans Rule
content:
**Rule.** When a returned payment on a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** billing an Owner Auto Policy term is made good, the amount re-collected for the returned payment itself depends on what that payment had paid:

| What the returned payment had paid | Amount re-collected for it |
|---|---|
| more than its invoice's minimum due (it also prepaid installments not yet invoiced) | only what that invoice still owes: its minimum due less the payments posted against it plus the returned amount |
| no installment invoice | nothing; the installments it prepaid are billed as scheduled |
| any other case | the returned amount |

The returned amount is the total returned against the payment; its invoice is the installment invoice it had paid; the payments posted against that invoice are read from the plan's ledger.

**Cases (hypothetical amounts)**

- A payment of 500.00 had paid an invoice with a minimum due of 190.00 and was returned in full; no other payment stands against the invoice. Re-collected: 190.00 less 500.00 plus 500.00, which is 190.00.
- A payment of 190.00 had paid an invoice with a minimum due of 190.00: re-collected 190.00, the returned amount.
- A payment linked to no installment invoice was returned: nothing is re-collected for it.
